script.story_title_en: The woman who said she hated bangles
script.logline_en: At a dusk bangle stall Dharani insists she does not like bangles on her birthday while her eyes keep going to one green set; Naveen asks her to say it looking at him, and the two read each other's eyes: she saw his worry, he saw her wish.
script.originality_note_en: A wife's loud 'I don't like bangles' is undone by her eyes, and a husband's quiet worry by his: each reads the other without a word, with the folded notes he saved in his shirt pocket as the proof.
script.meaning_ta: இரண்டு பேரின் கண்களும் ஒன்றையொன்று புரிந்துகொண்டுவிட்டால், அதன் பிறகு வாயால் சொல்லும் வார்த்தைகள் எந்தப் பயனும் தராது.
script.meaning_en: When two pairs of eyes have already understood each other, the words spoken afterwards add nothing.

cast.look_en: Tall and lean, long face, dark-brown skin, short neatly trimmed full beard, thick eyebrows, short black hair side-parted, kind steady eyes, no glasses.
cast.outfit_en: A blue-and-white checked half-sleeve cotton shirt with one chest pocket, grey trousers, a plain steel wristwatch.
cast.voice_en: a calm, warm 29-year-old Tamil man's voice

cast.look_en: Medium height, slim, fair-wheatish skin, oval face, long black hair in a loose side braid, a tiny gold nose stud, large kajal-lined eyes, a small maroon bindi, no glasses.
cast.outfit_en: A maroon cotton saree with a cream zari border, small gold stud earrings, a thin gold chain, bare wrists.
cast.voice_en: a bright, lively 26-year-old Tamil woman's voice

locations.description_en: A pavement bangle stall on a temple street in a Tamil Nadu town: a wooden frame with vertical bamboo pegs stacked with glass bangles in red, yellow, blue and green, a faded blue tarpaulin awning above with a string of warm yellow bulbs, a small wooden stool, a temple gopuram in silhouette far behind, other stalls softly blurred.
locations.light_en: Dusk, indigo sky with temple-lamp gold light and warm bulb light on faces; the same in every shot.
locations.blocking_en: Camera in front of the stall; Dharani stands centre-left facing the camera, Naveen at her right shoulder (frame right) turned towards her; the bangle pegs are behind them at the left, with the green set at eye level; nobody walks away.

props.description_en: Exactly one set of a dozen green glass bangles with tiny gold dots, tied with a red thread, hanging on a peg among the other colours until Naveen slides them onto Dharani's wrist.
Three soft, folded ten-rupee notes kept in Naveen's shirt pocket.

hooks.narration_ta: அவ கண்ணு ஒண்ணு சொல்லுது, வாய் ஒண்ணு சொல்லுது.

segments.speaker: dharani
segments.delivery: loud, bright and a little too quick, forced cheerfulness, said straight to camera; not really smiling

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: ஆனா, அவ கண்ணு அந்த வளையலையே பாக்குது.

segments.speaker: naveen
segments.narration_ta: நிஜமாவா, தரணி? என் கண்ணைப் பாத்து சொல்லு.
segments.delivery: calm, gentle, curious; a small steady smile

segments.speaker: dharani
segments.delivery: quiet, avoiding his eyes, a little tense; not smiling

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: நவீன் வாதாடல. அவ கண்ணை மட்டும் பாத்தான்.

segments.speaker: dharani
segments.narration_ta: உங்க கண்ணுல கவலை தெரிஞ்சுது... அதான் வேண்டாம்னேன்.
segments.delivery: soft, caught, tearful and tender, said facing camera

segments.speaker: naveen
segments.delivery: warm, quietly proud, a small smile

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.narration_ta: கண்ணொடு கண்இணை நோக்கொக்கின் வாய்ச்சொற்கள் என்ன பயனும் இல. கண்ணே பேசிட்டா, வாய்ச்சொல் எதுக்கு?

shots.action_en: Dharani, at the bangle stall, says loudly and too brightly that she does not like bangles; Naveen stands beside her, mouth closed, watching her.
shots.camera_en: Static medium shot from the front of the stall, Dharani centre-left facing camera, Naveen at her right shoulder.
shots.image_prompt_en: Dharani standing at the bangle stall facing the camera, bright over-cheerful face, hands clasped in front of her saree, wrists bare; Naveen at her right shoulder turned towards her, concerned, the green bangle set hanging on a peg at the left behind them.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Dharani looks to camera and says her line brightly and quickly, a forced cheerful face, no real smile in the eyes; Naveen stays still with mouth closed. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Dharani's eyes slip sideways to the green bangle set on the peg and back; then Naveen turns to her and asks her to say it looking into his eyes.
shots.camera_en: Static medium two-shot from the front, both faces in view.
shots.image_prompt_en: Dharani and Naveen at the stall; Dharani glancing sideways at the green bangle set on the peg at the left, her face still towards camera; Naveen turned to her, calm and curious, both faces visible.
shots.motion_prompt_en: For the first three seconds nobody speaks: Dharani's eyes slip to the green bangles and back. Then Naveen turns to her and says his line gently, a small steady smile; Dharani's mouth stays closed. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Dharani looks away from Naveen, uneasy, then says quietly that she said no and they should go home.
shots.camera_en: Static medium close-up on Dharani, her face fully to camera, the bangle stand soft behind her.
shots.image_prompt_en: Dharani, close, facing the camera, eyes lowered to the side then lifting, a tense uneasy mouth, bangle stand soft in the background; Naveen out of frame.
shots.motion_prompt_en: For the first three seconds Dharani keeps her eyes down and to the side, tense and quiet. Then she turns to camera and says her line quietly, not smiling. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Naveen says nothing and simply looks into Dharani's eyes; she gives in and says she saw worry in his eyes.
shots.camera_en: Static medium two-shot from the front, both faces in view, eyes meeting.
shots.image_prompt_en: Naveen and Dharani standing close at the stall, looking straight into each other's eyes, Naveen calm and still, Dharani's face softening, both faces clearly visible, both in the same positions as before.
shots.motion_prompt_en: For the first three seconds Naveen holds her gaze, silent, and Dharani looks back at him; neither moves from where they stand. Then Dharani turns to camera and says her line softly, tender and a little tearful; Naveen's mouth stays closed. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Naveen takes a few folded notes from his shirt pocket and holds them up with a quiet smile as he says his line; Dharani watches, mouth closed.
shots.camera_en: Static medium shot from the front, Naveen in focus facing the camera, Dharani at the edge of frame.
shots.image_prompt_en: Naveen facing the camera with a few folded ten-rupee notes held up in his right hand beside his shirt pocket, a quiet proud smile; Dharani at the left edge of frame, listening, moved, mouth closed; the green bangle set still on its peg.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Naveen takes the folded notes from his shirt pocket and says his line, warm and quietly proud, a small smile; Dharani stays still with mouth closed. Exactly one bangle set on the peg. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Naveen slides the green bangle set onto Dharani's wrist; she lifts her eyes and they look into each other's eyes without a word.
shots.camera_en: Static medium close two-shot from the front, hands low in frame, faces in view.
shots.image_prompt_en: Naveen gently holding Dharani's hand and sliding the green glass bangle set onto her wrist, both looking up into each other's eyes, soft smiles, warm bulb-light on their faces.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Naveen slides the green bangles onto Dharani's wrist; then both lift their eyes and look at each other, quietly smiling, nobody speaks. Exactly one bangle set, now on her wrist. Static locked-off camera.

shots.action_en: Dharani, now wearing the green bangles, holds her wrist up and laughs happily to camera; Naveen beside her, smiling; the first shot's framing again.
shots.camera_en: Static medium shot from the front of the stall, matching shot 1: Dharani centre-left facing camera, Naveen at her right shoulder.
shots.image_prompt_en: Dharani standing at the bangle stall facing the camera, the green glass bangles on her wrist raised near her cheek, a bright genuine smile; Naveen at her right shoulder, smiling at her; same framing as the opening shot.
shots.motion_prompt_en: Dharani shakes her wrist so the green bangles jingle and laughs warmly to camera; Naveen smiles at her. Nobody speaks. Static locked-off camera.

script.loop_note_en: The last shot repeats the first shot's framing, now with the green bangles on Dharani's wrist, and the closing tag line leads back to her opening bright 'I don't like bangles', so a replay makes you watch her eyes the second time.
